faqs.a:
Bimonthly user charges for residential service outside the city shall be based upon
               the following service charges and user rates; provided, however, there will be a bimonthly
               service charge regardless of usage as set forth in this section:
(1)
Single-family or other individually connected units:
a.
The bimonthly service charge is .....$43.66
b.
Plus, a bimonthly usage charge as follows: .....
1.
0—30,000 gallons per 1,000 .....$12.39
2.
From 30,001 to 60,000 gallons, per 1,000 .....$15.49
3.
From 60,001 to 90,000 gallons, per 1,000 .....$18.62
4.
All over 90,000 gallons, per 1,000 .....$24.81
(2)
Duplex, multifamily, townhouse, or other units that are interconnected:
a.
The total bimonthly service charge regardless of usage is as follows:

Plus, a bimonthly usage charge as follows:
1.

                  the rate of $12.39 per 1,000 gallons.
2.
30,001—60,000 gallons for the first unit plus 26,000 gallons for each additional unit
                  at the rate of $15.49 per 1,000 gallons.
3.
60,001—90,000 gallons for the first unit plus 39,000 gallons for each additional unit
                  at the rate of $18.62 per 1,000 gallons.
4.
All remaining usage at the rate of $24.81 per 1,000 gallons.
